exclusions: Participants whose self-reported native language (subject_information 'language') is not an English variant are dropped (paper: Exp1 6 of 120, Exp2 35 of 750). Blank / 'n/a' answers and mixed answers ('spanish & english') count as not English; typos of 'english' are kept. This gives 7 (Exp1) and 37 (Exp2) exclusions, not exactly the paper's counts, because the paper does not list its coding.
